newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Further gains seen likely for Belgian shares.
newsitem.headline: Further gains seen likely for Belgian shares.

text.p: Belgian shares, which ended firmer on Monday, could extend their gains, with fundamentals supporting and the prospect of a possible snap French election having little negative impact so far, dealers said.
"We're in a positive phase, though volume today was average to lower. Fundamentals are good," one dealer said.
The Bel-20 leading share index closed 11.49 points or 0.53 percent higher at 2,183.20, almost at the top of the day's 20-point trading range.
Volume was 2.7 billion francs worth of Belgian shares, compared to almost seven billion on Friday.

There were further signs of Bel-20 basket buying on Monday after the index was boosted sharply in late trading on Friday by baskets bought in preparation for the launch of new index-linked derivatives bank products, dealers said.

Sentiment was unaffected by Monday's near one-percent loss in the neighbouring French market where investors were later expecting confirmation that President Jacques Chirac was to hold a snap election. "There is no worry to Belgium of French elections," one dealer said.
Electrafina, which said on Friday it boosted its stake in French Suez rose 1.7 pct at 3,580 francs.
However two brokers said they still rated the stock a "hold", with its discount to net asset value in line with average.
